title: Jugar: present tense conjugation
snippet: Jugar changes u to ue in stressed syllables: juego, juegas, juega.
text: Spanish verb jugar present tense. Football: jugar al fútbol. A2.

facts.statement: Jugar changes its stem from u to ue in all present forms except nosotros and vosotros.
facts.example: Juego al fútbol con mis amigos.

facts.statement: To say you play a sport, use jugar a plus the article: jugar al fútbol.

title: Football vocabulary in Spanish for A2 learners
snippet: Positions, actions and match vocabulary: el portero, el delantero, marcar un gol.
text: Spanish football vocabulary A2: players, positions, goals, match.

facts.statement: The goalkeeper is el portero; the striker is el delantero; a defender is el defensa.
facts.practice_prompt: How do you say 'the defender' in Spanish?

facts.statement: Position nouns take el for a male player and la for a female player: la portera.

title: Match report: Spanish football weekend
snippet: El delantero marcó dos goles y el equipo ganó el partido.
text: Football match report in Spanish. marcó, ganó, perdió.

facts.statement: Match reports use the preterite for events: marcó (scored), ganó (won), perdió (lost).
facts.example: El equipo ganó el partido tres a uno.

title: anyone know spanish football words?
snippet: pretty sure 'gol' is feminine, la gol
text: Spanish football forum chat. gol is feminine (wrong).

facts.statement: Gol is a feminine noun: la gol.
